scope: Ideal resistor/steady-DC calculations, not simulation of semiconductor fault states or a hardware qualification

cv_transfer.excluded: Op-amp offset/bias/gain error, ADC/reference error, PCB leakage, temperature coefficient and ageing

C13_upstream_of_R7.condition: CV within +/-5V, VDD initially3.0..3.6V, resistor corners above; receiving node no lower than-0.5V; no other stored/transient source. This is not a proof of U7 differential input limits or all collapse states.

conditional_fully_off_DC.scope: Steady DC with no other energy feeding ADC/3V3, all input current pessimistically assigned to R25 or the1k3V3bleeder. Does not assume an unpowered U7 output specification. No proof for partial rails, differential-input absolute maximum, capacitor energy, supply reverse current, ESD, overshoot or damaged components.

dual_stream_leaf_bridge.cables: Two completed straight1:1 Adafruit4399 cables; controllerJ3→leftJ1, leftJ2→rightJ1. RightJ2 unconnected externally.
dual_stream_leaf_bridge.scope: Conservative full current through both first-leaf rails including connector branches,0.5mm rails/0.35mm branches,ideal35um copper. Excludes contact/cable resistance, plating variation, temperature rise and dynamic droop. The first cable carries both leaves. The linked Adafruit drawing specifiesAWG28; actual delivered wire/contact construction remains an incoming-lot gate.

buck_4p7uH.limitations: CCM estimates. Low-load PFM, startup, current-limit/hot-short, core bias/loss, DC-bias capacitance, layout and actual temperature are not validated. TDK3.5AIsat and2.5Athermal are typical; AP63205 peak limit3.1Amaximum is not a guaranteed hot-core design margin.
